records.body:

decisions.rationale: Owen is responsive and positive (email:91f6414d), already created a first project, so momentum exists with 8 days left. But he no-showed the welcome call (calendar:5aa54e9c), has sent no invites, and his open ask is a feature Wrenfield lacks (tick_87c21205bd3d, email:04fa1760), which may stall further use.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Glad it's feeling good so far, and thanks for the question about the weekly summary email — that one's still open with us. To answer it directly: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap.

You mentioned maybe taking me up on a walkthrough — happy to do that this week. I can also help you get your team lead into the workspace at the same time; a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week work?

Best,
Chidi
